envDependencies.SAP_FIORI_URL: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_FIORI_URL} in navigation steps
envDependencies.SAP_USERNAME: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_USERNAME} in login steps
envDependencies.SAP_PASSWORD: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_PASSWORD} in login steps

TD-CS-035-001.name: Valid Cold-Chain Outbound Delivery — Primary Happy Path
TD-CS-035-001.expectedOutcome: Outbound delivery created with unique delivery number; status Open/In Process; cold-chain shipping condition auto-proposed; packaging instructions displayed; temperature logger reference captured

TD-CS-035-NEG-001.name: Material Without Storage Condition Classification — No Cold-Chain Shipping Condition
TD-CS-035-NEG-001.expectedOutcome: Shipping condition NOT auto-populated; system does NOT enforce cold-chain requirements; delivery can be created without cold-chain carrier or temperature monitoring

TD-CS-035-NEG-002.name: Non-Qualified Carrier for Cold-Chain Material — Validation Error
TD-CS-035-NEG-002.expectedOutcome: SAP displays error: Carrier is not qualified for cold-chain transport; delivery NOT created

TD-CS-035-ERR-001.name: Missing Mandatory Field — Cold-Chain Carrier
TD-CS-035-ERR-001.note: coldChainCarrierId intentionally empty to test mandatory field enforcement
TD-CS-035-ERR-001.expectedOutcome: SAP highlights Carrier field as mandatory; displays error message; prevents save; delivery NOT created

TD-CS-035-ERR-002.name: Missing Mandatory Field — Temperature Logger Reference
TD-CS-035-ERR-002.note: temperatureLoggerReference intentionally empty to test mandatory field enforcement
TD-CS-035-ERR-002.expectedOutcome: SAP highlights Temperature Logger Reference field as mandatory; displays error message; prevents save; delivery NOT created

TD-CS-035-ERR-003.name: Missing Mandatory Field — Temperature Monitoring Device Reference (Goods Issue Block)
TD-CS-035-ERR-003.note: Delivery creation succeeds; temperatureMonitoringDeviceReference intentionally empty to test goods issue block
TD-CS-035-ERR-003.expectedOutcome: Delivery created successfully; goods issue posting blocked with error message; delivery status remains Open/In Process; goods issue status NOT Posted

TD-CS-035-EDGE-001.name: Minimum Quantity Boundary — Lower Limit
TD-CS-035-EDGE-001.expectedOutcome: Delivery created successfully with minimum quantity (1); all cold-chain requirements applied

TD-CS-035-EDGE-002.name: Maximum Length Temperature Logger Reference — Upper Boundary
TD-CS-035-EDGE-002.expectedOutcome: Delivery created successfully with maximum-length temperature logger reference (35-50 characters); full string stored without truncation
